notes: Asking your Kit about tasks works again. The chat's backlog tool had been quietly broken since a spring rework; your Kit would politely mention it couldn't check. It checks now.

Chat replies can no longer come back empty when a thinking-heavy model spends its whole budget thinking. Your Kit gives it more room once, and if that fails you get an honest error instead of a blank bubble.
The sign-in page is calmer: a crash on load is fixed, and it no longer drums the server or asks for a file that never shipped.
In Memories, the sunburst's title is readable again; its little Tier picker had been sitting on top of it and now lives at the bottom corner.

Sleep runs deeper repairs than before: the overnight identity scrub used to lose its database connection partway and silently give up; it now completes, and imports properly wait their turn while your Kit is dreaming.
